meta.title: An unregistered vendor's bid cannot be rejected after it was accepted, or twice
gaps: No setup recipe creates unregistered bids with B1 accepted, B2 already rejected, and two pending other bids.
No operation or library case rejects an unregistered bid after acceptance or rejects it twice.
No available token or operation provides the bid identifiers needed for read_bid.
No read-back fields or operation cover the contact's activation state or the pending count.
